title: Aliquoting Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package from the provided link and unzip it on your computer if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the supplied labware JSON files (with .json extension) to upload them.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol Python file (with .py extension) that contains the aliquoting script.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck of the robot to match the provided deck map, placing the source plate, destination plates, tip racks, and any other required labware in the indicated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate each piece of labware, the tip rack, and the pipette (P20 or P300) following the app’s calibration workflow. Refer to the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required parameters in the app, including the siRNA volume and any other settings; the protocol will generate a random 1‑4 plate map for aliquoting to four wells.

steps.title: Run aliquoting procedure
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’. The robot will automatically select the proper pipette (P20 or P300) based on the input siRNA volume, aspirate enough volume to cover all four destination wells plus overage, and dispense the aliquot to each of the four wells, using a fresh tip for each source‑destination set.
